caption: 3 ways to speed up your Python code #python #performance #coding
transcript: Here are three ways to make your Python code faster. First, use built-in functions and list comprehensions instead of manual loops. Second, profile before you optimize so you fix the real bottleneck. Third, cache expensive calls with functools lru_cache.
summary: Three practical tips for speeding up Python code: prefer built-ins and comprehensions, profile before optimizing, and cache repeated expensive calls.
takeaways: Built-in functions and list comprehensions are usually faster than hand-written loops.
Profile first so you optimize the actual bottleneck.
transcript_en: Here are three ways to make your Python code faster. First, use built-in functions and list comprehensions instead of manual loops. Second, profile before you optimize so you fix the real bottleneck. Third, cache expensive calls with functools lru_cache.
